# Real swatch files (s202, C5) -- test fixtures

Files written by other programs, kept unchanged so the selftest reads what
the world writes, not bytes we built by hand. Each keeps its source's licence.

| File | From | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| nsfmc-sampler.ase, nsfmc-solarized.ase | github.com/nsfmc/swatch (tests/) -- written by Illustrator | MIT, (C) 2011 Marcos Ojeda |
| hrbrmstr-herbs_and_spice.ase, hrbrmstr-tomorrow_night_eighties.aco, hrbrmstr-fourty.colors | github.com/hrbrmstr/swatches (inst/palettes/) | MIT, (C) 2015 Bob Rudis |
| szydlovski-swatches.aco | github.com/szydlovski/adobe-aco (test/) -- written by Photoshop | MIT, (C) 2021 szydlovski |
| dtpstudio-CIE-LAB.sbz | Scribus (resources/swatches/CIE-LAB.sbz), by dtp studio oldenburg (www.dtpstudio.de) | CC BY-ND 4.0 -- redistributed unmodified |

Also read by hand in s202 (not kept here): all 62 Scribus .xml swatch files
and its other two .sbz (CIE-HLC, Wikipedia RAL Classic) -- every colour count
matched the file's.
